class EveryBlock private constructor(state: State) : Batched, Dynamic, CollisionDetector, Editable<EveryBlock>, KeyboardInputAware {

    override val isAlwaysActive = true

    private var timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0L
    private var timer2PeriodInMilliseconds = 0L

    /**
     * Whether its sprite's frames start over after the last one.

    override fun onAdded(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        actorManager = kubriko.get()
        viewportManager = kubriko.get()
        keyboardInputManager = kubriko.get()
        stateManager = kubriko.get()
        generatedScenes = kubriko.get()
        generatedAudio = kubriko.get()
        spriteManager = kubriko.get()
        everyManagerManager = kubriko.get()
        onAddedToScene(kubriko)
    }

    override fun update(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        if (isRemoved) return
        animation.stepForward(deltaTimeInMilliseconds, animationSpeed, isAnimationLooping)
        if (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {
            spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {
                spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = if (spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds > 0) (spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds + spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds).coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
                onSpawnEnemyFinished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
            }
        }
        if (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {
            timer1RemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {
                timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = if (timer1PeriodInMilliseconds > 0) (timer1RemainingInMilliseconds + timer1PeriodInMilliseconds).coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
                onTimer1Finished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
            }
        }
        if (timer2RemainingInMilliseconds > 0) {
            timer2RemainingInMilliseconds -= deltaTimeInMilliseconds
            if (timer2RemainingInMilliseconds <= 0) {
                timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = if (timer2PeriodInMilliseconds > 0) (timer2RemainingInMilliseconds + timer2PeriodInMilliseconds).coerceAtLeast(1) else 0
            }
        }
        onEveryFrame(deltaTimeInMilliseconds)
        body.position += velocity * (deltaTimeInMilliseconds.coerceAtMost(33) / 1000f)
        val box = body.axisAlignedBoundingBox
        val sceneSettings = generatedScenes.settings
        val leftEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.topLeft.value.x else sceneSettings.topLeft.x
        val rightEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.bottomRight.value.x else sceneSettings.bottomRight.x
        val topEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.topLeft.value.y else sceneSettings.topLeft.y
        val bottomEdge = if (sceneSettings == null) viewportManager.bottomRight.value.y else sceneSettings.bottomRight.y
        val isTouchingLeftEdge = box.min.x < leftEdge
        val isTouchingRightEdge = box.max.x > rightEdge
        val isTouchingTopEdge = box.min.y < topEdge
        val isTouchingBottomEdge = box.max.y > bottomEdge
        if (isTouchingLeftEdge || isTouchingRightEdge || isTouchingTopEdge || isTouchingBottomEdge) {
            body.position += SceneOffset(
                if (isTouchingLeftEdge) leftEdge - box.min.x else if (isTouchingRightEdge) rightEdge - box.max.x else SceneUnit.Zero,
                if (isTouchingTopEdge) topEdge - box.min.y else if (isTouchingBottomEdge) bottomEdge - box.max.y else SceneUnit.Zero,
            )
            onEdgeTouched(deltaTimeInMilliseconds, isTouchingLeftEdge, isTouchingRightEdge, isTouchingTopEdge, isTouchingBottomEdge)
        }
        collisionMask.position = bodyCenter
        collisionMask.rotation = body.rotation
    }

    override fun onCollisionDetected(collidables: List<Collidable>) {
        if (isRemoved) return
        for (index in collidables.indices) {
            when (val other = collidables[index]) {
                is EveryBlock -> if (!other.isRemoved) onCollisionWithEveryBlock(other)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onAddedToScene(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onEveryFrame(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onEdgeTouched(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int, isTouchingLeftEdge: Boolean, isTouchingRightEdge: Boolean, isTouchingTopEdge: Boolean, isTouchingBottomEdge: Boolean) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        if (isTouchingLeftEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
        if (isTouchingRightEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(-velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
        if (isTouchingTopEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
        if (isTouchingBottomEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, -velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue

                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }

                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onKeyPressedDirectionLeft() {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onKeyPressedDirectionDown() {
        if (keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.DirectionDown)) {
            if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Held".let { logged ->
                Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onCollisionWithEveryBlock(other: EveryBlock) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        bounceOff(other)
        other.isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(other)
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    setFrame(2)
                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                    repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                        setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                    }
                                                    if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                            if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                    score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                    }
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
                                                    velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
                                                    // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
                                                    isRemoved = true
                                                    actorManager.remove(this)
                                                    bounceOff(other)
                                                    other.isRemoved = true
                                                    actorManager.remove(other)
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        val speed = velocity.x
                                                        if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                    }
                                                    score = -1f
                                                    score += 0.5f
                                                    title = "Game \"over\""
                                                    isShielded = false
                                                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
                                                        Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                    }
                                                    run {
                                                        if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
                                                    }
                                                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    run {
                                                        val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
                                                        var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
                                                        var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
                                                        for (index in actors.indices) {
                                                            val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                                                            if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                                                            val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                                                            val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                                                            if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                                                                nearest = candidate
                                                                nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                        if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
                                                    }
                                                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
                                                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
                                                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
                                                    timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
                                                    // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
                                                }
                                                if (score <= 3f) {
                                                    repeat(2) {
                                                        if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                                                            if (isShielded) {
                                                                if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                                                                    if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                                                            if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                                                                if (false) {
                                                                                    velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                                                } else {
                                                                                    // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                                                                    isRemoved = true
                                                                                    actorManager.remove(this)
                                                                                }
                                                                                everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                                                                everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                                                                everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                                                                // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                                                // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                                                if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                                                                    if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                                                        if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                                                            if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->
                                                                                                Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
                                                                                                println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
                                                                                            }
                                                                                            run {
                                                                                                actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                                                            }
                                                                                            generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                                                            generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                                                            // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                                                            generatedScenes.restart()
                                                                                            stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                                                            stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                                                            stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                                                            generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                                                            generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                                                            // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                                                            generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                                                            generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                                                            // Choose music for this Block.
                                                                                            generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                                                            setFrame(2)
                                                                                            animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                                                            isAnimationLooping = false
                                                                                            velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                                                            body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                                                            score = -1.5f
                                                                                            score += 0f
                                                                                            spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                                                            spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                                                            timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = (score * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                                                                            timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = timer1RemainingInMilliseconds
                                                                                            repeat(KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(2, 5)) {
                                                                                                setFrame(everyManagerManager.score.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0))
                                                                                            }
                                                                                            if (score > everyManagerManager.score) {
                                                                                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(10, 21).toFloat()) {
                                                                                                    if (velocity.x < 0f.sceneUnit) {
                                                                                                    }
                                                                                                }
                                                                                            }
                                                                                            actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(SceneOffset((generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.RIGHT) + 50f).sceneUnit, generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 10f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, -10f).sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                                                            body.position = SceneOffset(generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.LEFT).sceneUnit, (generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM) - 2.5f).sceneUnit)
                                                                                            score += generatedScenes.edge(GeneratedScenes.TOP)
                                                                                            // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                                                            if (score < generatedScenes.randomBetweenEdges(GeneratedScenes.TOP, 0f, GeneratedScenes.BOTTOM, 0f)) {
                                                                                            }
                                                                                        }
                                                                                    }
                                                                                }
                                                                            }
                                                                        }
                                                                    }
                                                                }
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onTimer1Finished(deltaTimeInMilliseconds: Int) {
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in an edge Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}".let { logged ->
            Logger.log(message = logged, source = "EveryBlock")
            println("[EveryBlock] " + logged.replace('\n', ' '))
        }
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f + sin(0f)
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true

                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}".let { logged ->

                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()

                                                    animationSpeed = -0.5f
                                                    isAnimationLooping = false
                                                    velocity = SceneOffset((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 100f - 50f).sceneUnit, KubrikoWiring.random.nextInt(1, 4).toFloat().sceneUnit)
                                                    body.position = SceneOffset(score.sceneUnit, everyManagerManager.score.sceneUnit)
                                                    score = -1.5f
                                                    score += 0f
                                                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = ((KubrikoWiring.random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 0.5f) * 1000f + 0.5f).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
